meaning: Top 60 species per format. Usage is source species usage. Up to 32 entries retained per marginal; coverage records truncation. Marginal weights are raw source counts/weights, not joint probabilities. Mode combinations are constructed candidate sets, never claimed as observed teams. EV fields carry Champions stat points. Individual-set validation only.
